description: Starts the song at the point that makes the video's first cut land exactly on the drop (checked with the Studio's own timing, within one frame); later cuts stay on the beat grid. It uses the drop read_music_structure reports, by trimming the song's start (the person's own uploaded or generated tracks only). Uses no credit; undoable. A track still being made or analysed reports that, and the alignment can be done once the track is ready.
name: align_first_cut_to_drop
title: First cut on the drop
